summary: A Depth subscription whose book comes before the scrip's first quote: the book goes out alone, and once the first symbol-feed snapshot comes it goes again with the quote (audit P-07).

deviations.reason: The web's Fyers adapter sends data.mode its own way (the subscription mode number, or no key); the desktop sends its label (ltp, quote, full). Lead rule 2026-11-09: this follows each broker's own web adapter (lane wire's per-broker dialect switch; bk-a sets the entry in phase B).
The web's Fyers adapter stamps timestamp with int(time.time()), epoch seconds; feed timestamps are epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md), as the desktop sends them.

Whether and how a frame carries ltt (in LTP frames, or beside the broker's own trade-time name) follows the web's Fyers adapter; the desktop always sends ltt in ms. deviations.reason: The web's Fyers frames carry the broker's exchange token; the desktop's frames do not. Lane wire to decide whether the carrier passes broker tokens.
The web's Fyers frames carry the mapper's data_type label; the desktop's do not (a web-internal key a client can read). Lane wire to decide.

The web sends HSM's exchange feed time (exch_feed_time, epoch s) as exchange_time; the desktop's common carrier drops it.
The web also sends the Fyers-era name last_traded_time beside last_trade_time; the desktop sends only last_trade_time (feed::dialect). An alias for lane wire.
The web sends the change since the previous close on every Fyers instrument; the desktop's frames carry it for indices only (audit C04, lane wire).

A depth frame keeps ltp, which the SDK's Depth callback reads: 0 before the instrument's first quote; the web's Fyers depth before the first quote has no ltp (CLAUDE.md, the compatibility contract).

Before the scrip's first quote the desktop's book frame sends the book totals as 0 (HSM's depth feed carries none, depth_event takes them from the symbol feed); the web leaves them out. A total the stream did not carry must be left out, not sent as 0.
